description: Adobe and Google are adding new integrations across their productivity and creative software. Acrobat will work with Google Drive and Gmail, while Gemini models will power several of its AI features. Users will also be able to access select Adobe apps through Gemini and Gemini Enterprise. Google's image and video generation models are coming to Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere and Adobe Express. Separately, Adobe and Google DeepMind are exploring a Photoshop feature that could let users edit images through text prompts.
title: Adobe and Google Expand Partnership With Gemini AI Models, Photoshop Features

description: Opensignal's latest Fixed Broadband Experience Report states that Airtel is India's Best Home Internet. Its lead is broadest in reliability and speed, where it is15 percent ahead of Jio on Reliability and 26-27 percent faster on download and upload speed. In the reliability category, Airtel recorded a score of 486 on Opensignal's 100–1,000 scale. Jio secured 423 points.
title: Airtel Beats Jio and BSNL in Internet Speed and Reliability, Says Opensignal Report

description: Across Protocol has regained control of its website following a domain hijacking incident on November 10 that redirected visitors to a fraudulent page. The attack reportedly involved social engineering targeting domain registrar Namecheap rather than an exploit of the bridge's smart contracts. Cybersecurity firm GoPlus Security estimated that approximately $350,000 was stolen from cryptocurrency wallets across multiple networks. Across temporarily suspended its frontend and API services while working with security teams to remove the phishing website. The protocol has pledged to compensate affected users.
title: Across Protocol Recovers Website After Hackers Seize Control of Domain

description: Samsung is reportedly working on a call recording feature for third-party apps as part of One UI 9.5. An early version of the Phone app includes a dedicated setting that lists compatible services and lets users enable recording separately for each one. WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet have appeared in the screenshots so far. The feature may come with restrictions based on local call recording laws, and Samsung could also leave users responsible for informing other participants when they record a conversation.
title: Samsung One UI 9.5 May Bring Call Recording to WhatsApp, Telegram

description: Initia has confirmed its second security breach in less than three weeks, with attackers stealing approximately $3.27 million (roughly Rs. 30.63 crore) through a compromised Google Cloud Platform key. The November 10 incident involved a command injection attack that exposed the network's environment variables, GitHub and cloud accounts. Attackers subsequently exploited its Anvil rollup infrastructure to execute fraudulent IBC withdrawals across five rollups. Initia said around $2.16 million in affected assets remained on its suspended network, while recovery efforts continued with law enforcement and security partners.
title: Initia Confirms Another Hack as Attackers Steal $3.27 Million in Three Weeks

description: Samsung is reportedly developing a smartphone with a display that slides vertically to change its aspect ratio. A tipster claims the screen will switch between 16:9 and 21:9 formats, although these details have not been confirmed. A recently published patent also shows a design with two sliding sections connected by a flexible display. The mechanism could affect battery capacity and internal space. Samsung is separately expected to launch its first rollable smartphone, possibly called the Galaxy Z Roll, in 2028.
title: Samsung Tipped to Be Working on Vertically Expandable Phone With Sliding Display

description: Google has announced its November 2026 Pixel Drop. The new update brings AI-powered features, personalisation options and connectivity improvements to its Pixel devices. It adds Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10 smartphones. The update includes new widgets and improved Call Screen capabilities. The sale of Google's Pixel Tag started in the US.
title: Google November 2026 Pixel Drop Brings Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10 Series; Pixel Tag Goes on Sale

description: Google announced the rollout of Gemini 4 Carbon on Tuesday. Following its release last month, the Mountain View-based tech giant is expanding access to developers and enterprises through paid plans. Meanwhile, Google AI Ultra subscribers can also use it across select products, including the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search. Compared to Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon is claimed to be capable of handling more demanding, multi-step tasks by spending more time reasoning and verifying its output.
title: Gemini 4 Carbon Now Available to Developers and Google AI Ultra Subscribers

description: OpenAI's new business offering includes tools for managing company profiles, sharing product information and tracking engagement on ChatGPT. Businesses can add feeds with current prices and availability, while aggregated insights show how often they appear in conversations and how many users visit their websites. The platform also lets eligible companies publish AI agents to handle customer queries and product comparisons. Business profile management is rolling out in supported markets, while Business Agents are currently limited to eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the US.
title: OpenAI Launches Businesses in ChatGPT, Lets Companies Manage Profiles and Deploy AI Agents

description: OpenAI will retire the Advanced and Standard Voice models in ChatGPT Voice on December 11, the company has announced. Users will no longer be able to select either model from ChatGPT Voice’s settings menu. After the transition, ChatGPT Voice will be powered only by GPT-Live. The company started notifying users about the transition on Tuesday. OpenAI says that users can continue to use the two voice models during the transition period. The Sam Altman-led company says that since the launch of the GPT-Live model in July, the usage of ChatGPT Voice has “nearly doubled”. OpenAI claims that “virtually all” ChatGPT Voice users now use GPT-Live for conversations with the AI chatbot.
title: OpenAI to Retire Advanced and Standard Voice Models in ChatGPT Next Month as GPT-Live Usage Spikes

description: Apple's first iOS 27.3 beta reportedly includes references to new AI-powered Health features for Siri. The update could let the voice assistant search users' Health app information. It could access the activity records, workout details, sleep summaries and medication logs. The stable version of iOS 27.3 is expected to arrive next month.
title: iOS 27.3 Could Let Siri Access Your Health Data, Including Sleep, Workouts and Medications

description: Telegram announced a new feature on Tuesday that turns ordinary messages into interactive mini-apps. The cross-platform social media and instant messaging service claims users can access tools and services directly within their conversations. The feature is said to be part of the latest Bot API update, which lets developers create HTML-based widgets that run inside message bubbles. Separately, Telegram is also adding support for TON (The Open Network) Connect transactions.
title: Telegram’s New Bot API Update Turns Messages Into Interactive Mini-Apps, Adds Support for Crypto Payments

description: Sony has cancelled yet another live service project. The PlayStation parent has reportedly cancelled the development of Fairgames at Haven Studios. No employees will be laid off as a result of the cancellation. Fairgames was announced in 2023 as a multiplayer heist game. The game did not have a release window.
title: Sony Reportedly Cancels Live Service Shooter Fairgames After 'Mixed' Playtest

description: Spotify has expanded its AI-powered DJ feature with new voice options and additional playback controls. The music streaming platform launched seven new English-speaking voices and two Spanish-speaking voices. It also allows users to disable commentary between songs. Spotify said the expanded voice selection and commentary controls are now available for Premium subscribers in markets where its AI DJ feature is already available.
title: Spotify AI DJ Gets New Voices in English and Spanish With Indian Accent, Option to Turn Off Commentary

description: Infinix Xpad 30 is the latest addition to the company's budget tablet lineup, the company has announced. It is currently available for purchase in the Philippines via Shopee and Lazada. The tablet is offered in three colour options, namely Cloudline Blue, Lunar Lilac, and Stellar Grey. The Infinix Xpad 30 runs Android 16-based XOS 16 and ships with the company’s suite of AI tools, dubbed Infinix AI. The tablet sports an 11-inch Full-HD+ (1,200 x 1,920 pixels) IPS LCD touchscreen, offering up to a 90Hz refresh rate, 450 nits peak brightness, Panda MN228 cover glass, 72 percent colour gamut, 30KHz PWM Dimming, and 180Hz touch sampling rate. The screen also ships with TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light and Flicker Free certifications.
title: Infinix Xpad 30 Launched With 11-Inch Full-HD+ Display, 7,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Suiball, a hardware wallet project built for the Sui blockchain, has announced that it will shut down and refund all pre-orders after the Sui Foundation declined to support the product over security concerns. The decision came just before the first batch of devices was due to ship, following repeated attacks targeting cryptocurrency hardware wallets. Around 80 percent of pre-orders were placed directly on-chain and will receive automatic USDC refunds. Credit card customers will receive separate instructions to complete the process.
title: Sui-Based Hardware Wallet Suiball Suspends Operations and Initiates Refunds

description: Kora is built around an AI engine called Cortex, which distributes processing across a PC's CPU, GPU and NPU. The Linux-based platform also introduces neural workspaces for managing projects and AI agents, alongside a file system that supports content-based searches. It will include GameFrame for PC gaming and support models from different providers. Kora is expected to be available as a free download, with paid subscriptions for AI services. A separate enterprise platform, HUMAIN OS, is also planned for 2027.
title: Kora Unveils AI-Powered Linux OS That Lets AI Agents Work Across Apps and Files

description: Anthropic announced the expansion of Claude's capabilities beyond its existing chat and coding tools. According to the company, users will be able to access new ways for teams to create and work with data. Among the notable additions are Claude Sheets, Claude Whiteboards, and Claude Data, which allow users to build spreadsheets, organise ideas, and create interactive dashboards with the chatbot. Further, Anthropic is also upgrading interactive connectors, which let users access third-party applications without leaving Claude.
title: Claude Gets New Spreadsheet, Whiteboard, and Dashboard Tools Alongside Interactive Connectors

description: Apple has announced a fresh set of games for its Arcade subscription service as part of its updated lineup for December. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, SEGA’s Football Manager 27 Touch has already been added, while four more games are scheduled to arrive next month. The upcoming lineup includes a revamped take on a popular tower defence game, a new card-based roguelike, an action-adventure title set in a mythological world, and a family-friendly LEGO experience.
title: Apple Arcade Gets Football Manager 27 Touch; Plants vs. Zombies and Prince of Persia Planned for December

description: With the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max models launched in China, Vivo is now gearing up for their India launch. With the X500 series officially marked as “Coming Soon” on the Vivo website, a new colourway of the X500 model has emerged online. This colourway wasn’t released at the China launch, but has been spotted in unboxings outside the country, hinting that it could be coming to global markets.
title: Vivo X500 in Red Colourway Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: Bitcoin and Ethereum declined on Wednesday as stronger-than-expected US inflation data reinforced expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike. Bitcoin recovered from its overnight low of $72,691 but remained below $75,000. Meanwhile, US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs recorded combined outflows of $385.6 million.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $73,700 as US Inflation Fears and ETF Outflows Weigh on Crypto Market

description: WhatsApp head Kunal Shah has outlined plans for the platform. He says WhatsApp is working to simplify everyday activities on the platform, with plans to improve communication features. It will bring more services into chats and introduce AI-powered assistance. The company also reiterated its commitment to keeping personal messages and calls end-to-end encrypted.
title: WhatsApp Outlines Plans for AI Features, Improved Voice Notes, Simpler Payments, and More

description: Oppo has revealed the camera configuration of the Oppo Reno 17 series in China. The smartphone maker announced that the Oppo Reno 17 series will feature a 50-megapixel primary camera on the back, along with a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto shooter and a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera. Lastly, in China, the lineup will be equipped with a 50-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls with a wide field of view, housed inside a hole-punch display cutout. Apart from this, tipster Yogesh Brar claims that the Oppo Reno 17 Pro will not be launched globally, while also putting its anticipated debut in India in question. The leaker has also shared the specifications of the global version of the Oppo Reno 17.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Pro Tipped Not to Launch Globally, as Oppo Reno 17 Key Specifications and Features Surface Online

description: Qualcomm is said to be initiating a major workforce reduction in India. According to reports, the US-based semiconductor company is handing out termination notices to employees, with senior engineers and employees with several years of experience said to be among those impacted. While Qualcomm has not officially confirmed the number of job cuts, estimates suggest that between 600 and 1,200 positions could be at risk. The restructuring is also allegedly taking place in the US and other markets.
title: Qualcomm India Layoffs: Why Senior Engineers Are Affected and What They’re Getting

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will be available to stream on Xbox consoles via Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch, Microsoft and Rockstar Games have announced. The game will be streamable on Xbox Series S/X and Xbox One consoles, allowing previous-gen Xbox users to play the game. Cloud streaming for GTA 6 will begin at 1am ET on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Can Be Streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series S/X and Xbox One at Launch

description: The Adobe Max conference was held on Tuesday, where the company announced a fresh set of AI-powered tools and workflow improvements for its Creative Cloud suite. As per the US-based software company, there are new capabilities in Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, Illustrator, InDesign, and Firefly. These are said to be aimed at making image and video editing less time-consuming, automating repetitive creative tasks, and improving collaboration across applications. Adobe has also outlined plans to let users connect its creative applications with third-party AI assistants.
title: Adobe Max 2026: Photoshop, Premiere Get New AI Features, ChatGPT Integration Planned for 2027

description: Reddit has introduced a new artificial intelligence (AI)-powered shopping tool, called Reddit Reviews. Reddit said the initial testing phase will include about 10,000 products frequently discussed across its communities. The selection covers four categories. The company plans to introduce additional products and categories throughout 2027.
title: Reddit Announces Reddit Reviews to Turn Community Discussions Into Dedicated Product Reviews

description: Amazon has introduced two mobile security cameras under its Ring brand, with one built for home surveillance and the other aimed at businesses. The Drone Cam records in 2K resolution and can fly to preset locations when compatible security devices detect activity. The Rover Cam moves on wheels and supports 4K recording, two-way audio and a periscope camera. Both use the company's AI Pilot navigation system and include privacy features. They are currently announced for the US market, with no India launch details yet.
title: Amazon Ring Drone Cam, Ring Rover Cam Launched With AI-Powered Navigation: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy S27+ has been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website with the model number SM-S956B/DS. The phone is said to arrive along with the Samsung Galaxy S27, which has also previously been spotted in the BIS certification database with the model number SM-S952B/DS. However, neither listing reveals any details about the two upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 series handsets. The lineup is also expected to include the Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra. The tech giant has yet to confirm these details.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27+ India Launch Seems Imminent as Handset Visit BIS Website, Tipster Claims

description: Google has introduced two new Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) systems as part of the eighth-generation lineup, the tech giant announced on Tuesday. The TPU 8tx is designed and optimised for secure and confidential AI inference. The company claims that the chip can also be used for small-scale training of AI models. Google’s TPU 8tx is built for regulated enterprises and governments who want to run frontier or proprietary AI models and autonomous AI agents, while ensuring the security of their sensitive data. On the other hand, the TPU 8i Max system is built for “massive” context windows and the “highest compute” density per rack. It is claimed to scale compute and memory in lockstep, which enables 2x compute, SRAM bandwidth, and HBM bandwidth. The TPU system is claimed to fit 2x the silicon within existing racks, allowing data centres to “deploy significantly more computing power per square foot and per watt”.
title: Google Expands Eighth-Generation TPU Portfolio With 8tx and 8i Max Chips for Secure AI Inference, High Compute Density

description: Nothing’s Founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Carl Pei, has teased the design of the tech firm’s first AI-native device. The company executive wrote, “Context doesn't live in a chat box”, which could be a reference to how users interact with AI through chatbots, hinting that the new device could eliminate the need for them to open a chatbot to ask queries. Nothing’s AI-native might also be able to remember context during conversations and present answers based on past interactions. In terms of design, the teaser shows Nothing’s upcoming AI-native device with a metal case and textured body. The AI hardware also appears with two pill-shaped LEDs in red and green. Below the LEDs, a white button with a red dot has been placed, which appears to be a physical trigger for recording.
title: Nothing Reveals Design of Its First Screenless ‘AI-Native Device’ With LED Lights, Metallic Finish

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has been confirmed to target 30fps on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series S/X. The game will launch without a 60fps Performance mode on consoles. The game will also get improved image clarity through PSSR and ray-traced shadows on PS5 Pro. Rockstar Games has also detailed PS5-specific features for the game.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Target 30fps on Consoles; Rockstar Confirms PS5 Features
